description: The schedule structure used independently by the Windows tray runtime and Tampermonkey userscript.

settings.timezone: A timezone identifier detected on first setup and editable later.

periods.end: 24-hour HH:mm local time. An earlier end is the following day.

rules: Each period receives one independently chosen start offset and one independently chosen end offset in its inclusive configured range.
Resolved offsets are persisted per schedule date and settings revision, so an app or browser restart does not change them.
The active state is true when any resolved period contains the current time.
Overnight periods are supported by treating an end at or before its start as occurring on the following calendar day.
